    Questions
    

    What do you work on?
    Roofing (repair, replacement, flat roofs), gutters and downspouts, windows, siding, soffit and fascia, chimneys, doors, skylights, waterproofing and most other exterior repairs.
    

    How long have you been doing this?
    Chema JL LLC has 22 years of experience in roofing and exterior work.
    

    Can you fix a small leak, or only full roofs?
    Both. Small repairs and full replacements are part of what we do.
    

    Can I get several jobs done at once?
    Yes. Roof, gutters, windows and siding often go together, and one crew can handle all of it. Select every service you need in the estimate form.
    

    How do I reach you fastest?
    Call (718) 607-7591.
